bio: I am a cognitive neuroscientist in the Cognitive Psychology department at VU Amsterdam and PI in the Conscious Brain Lab. In the Conscious Brain Lab I investigate consciousness, perceptual bias, confidence, and automatic sensory control, and how the attribution of epistemic properties to AI affects critical thinking and decision making. I developed the open-source ADAM toolbox for multivariate EEG/MEG decoding.
name: Johannes Fahrenfort
